Knowledge Compiler

Compile messy slide decks, PDFs, Office docs, and coding-agent sessions into a verified, local-first OKF v0.3 knowledge graph
Readable out of the box by generic OKF tools, AI coding agents, GitHub, Obsidian, and the built-in 60 FPS 3D WebGL workbench.

Live 3D Demo ↗ · v1.3.1 · CI · OKF v0.3 Strict · okf.md · Python 3.10+ · Apache-2.0

60-Second Demo · OKF v0.3 Interoperability · WebGL Workbench · Skills & CLI · Offline Proof


![Compile Once into OKF v0.3, Consume Anywhere](assets/okf-ecosystem-flow.svg) --- ## Why Compiled OKF Beats Raw Prompting and RAG Chunking Most coding-agent knowledge setups fail in one of three ways: stuffing 100-page slide decks directly into context windows, slicing tables and diagrams into arbitrary 500-token RAG chunks, or trapping notes inside a proprietary format that external tools cannot read. **Knowledge Compiler** implements Google Cloud's [**Open Knowledge Format (`OKF v0.3`)**](https://github.com/open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format) (with full `OKF v0.2` backward compatibility) and Andrej Karpathy's compiled LLM-Wiki pattern as a pure-Python CLI and portable agent plugin: - **Progressive Disclosure Instead of Context Saturation**: Agents scan a `~500`-token root `index.md` and follow 1-hop / 2-hop links to only the exact dossiers they need. - **Structured Provenance Instead of Lossy Chunks**: Preserves Markdown tables, inline Mermaid architecture diagrams, footnote citations, verification freshness (`verified[].at >= generated.at`), and deprecation chains (`status: deprecated` + `superseded_by`). - **Open Standards Instead of Lock-In**: Emits plain UTF-8 Markdown with RFC 3986 relative `.md` links, frontmatter-free `wiki/**/index.md` sub-indexes (§8), and namespaced `x-kc-*` epistemic extensions (§4.1), passing upstream `open-knowledge-format` `validate.py --strict` with **`0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 info`**. --- ## Quick Start (60-Second Walkthrough) **Prerequisites**: Python `>= 3.10` (`>= 3.11` recommended) and Git on Windows, macOS, or Linux. Zero cloud accounts or API keys required. ```bash git clone https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-compiler.git cd knowledge-compiler python3 -m pip install -e ".[extract]" ``` ### 1. Explore the Included 21-Note OKF v0.3 Starter Vault The repository ships a clean-room Google Cloud architecture vault in [`examples/starter-vault/`](examples/starter-vault/index.md) (`32` total Markdown files, `434` standard inter-note relative Markdown links, `0` prose wikilinks, `57` `x-kc-*` epistemic edges, `10` inline Mermaid diagrams, `33` GFM tables, a deprecated concept with `superseded_by`, and an `Attested Computation`): ```bash # Audit strict OKF v0.3 conformance, relative Markdown links, [[wikilinks]], and footnotes vault-lint examples/starter-vault --strict # Query with zero-index-file Okapi BM25 ranking (no .sqlite files created) vault-query "BigQuery partition pruning" --vault examples/starter-vault # Launch the 60 FPS 2D/3D WebGL Workbench & inline Mermaid/table Reader (http://127.0.0.1:8765) vault-graph examples/starter-vault ``` ### 2. Initialize or Upgrade Your Own Knowledge Vault ```bash # Scaffold a fresh OKF v0.3 vault (bundle root '.', compiled concepts in wiki/) vault-init --target ~/KnowledgeVault # Extract a slide deck, PDF, Office doc, or web page into raw/ (with SHA-256 caching) vault-extract /path/to/architecture-deck.pptx --vault ~/KnowledgeVault # Upgrade an existing OKF v0.2 vault (index.md, log.md, bundle paths, x-kc-* keys, wiki/**/index.md) vault-lint ~/KnowledgeVault --fix --migrate-v03 # Optional: convert legacy Obsidian [[wikilinks]] into portable OKF v0.3 relative Markdown links vault-lint ~/KnowledgeVault --fix --migrate-v03 --portable-links # Optional: install portable skills & enable opt-in Git sync hooks for non-Marketplace setups kc-install-plugin vault-hooks enable ``` --- ## Compile Once, Consume Anywhere Every vault compiled by **Knowledge Compiler** uses standard OKF v0.3 conventions so the exact same directory works across the entire OKF ecosystem without exporters or proprietary databases: | Consumer | What Works Out of the Box | | :--- | :--- | | **Generic OKF v0.3 Consumers** (`validate.py`, `okf-consume`, `viz.html`, CI) | Sees the complete link graph (`bundle_root: "."`, RFC 3986 relative `.md` links, frontmatter-free `wiki/**/index.md` catalogs, `x-kc-*` §4.1 extensions, and fail-closed staleness). | | **AI Coding Agents** (Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) | Native root `plugin.json` + **10 portable `SKILL.md` workflows** + `rules/AGENTS.md` progressive-disclosure guidelines. | | **Built-In 60 FPS WebGL Workbench** (`vault-graph`, `127.0.0.1:8765`) | Zero-CDN 3D Orbit & 2D Force graph, `WASD` camera flight, inline SVG Mermaid & GFM table Reader, in-memory BM25 Search Hub, and 1-click standalone HTML export. | | **Obsidian & GitHub** | Every inter-note link clicks straight through natively on GitHub and inside Obsidian, while remaining 100% backward-compatible with Obsidian `[[wikilinks]]` and OKF v0.2 vaults. | --- ## Interactive 60 FPS WebGL Workbench `vault-graph` launches a **zero-CDN, loopback-only (`127.0.0.1:8765`)** workbench designed to stay smooth at 60 FPS even on GPU-less Linux VMs and remote desktops: ![60 FPS 3D WebGL Workbench and Inline Mermaid and Table Reader](assets/webgl-workbench-preview.svg) - **3D WebGL Orbit & 2D Force Views**: Hardware-accelerated WebGL2/WebGL1 shaders with a single-pass Batched Turbo 2D fallback, `WASD` + `Shift` sprint flight, PageRank node sizing, and 1-hop / 2-hop BFS spotlighting. - **Split-Pane OKF v0.3 Reader**: Renders inline CSP-safe SVG Mermaid diagrams (`flowchart`/`graph`, `sequenceDiagram`, `pie`) with full-screen lightbox (`Expand`), formatted GFM tables, YAML trust metadata, and clickable relative `.md` link navigation. - **First-Run Sample Preview & Offline Export**: Switch between your own vault and the built-in 21-note read-only `Sample Vault` in one click, or emit a single self-contained HTML artifact with `vault-graph --export`.
View Search Hub & Multi-Mode Web UI Architecture
![2D/3D WebGL Orbit Graph and Search Hub](assets/webgl-search-hub.svg)
--- ## 4-Layer OKF v0.3 Vault Architecture Every compiled vault maintains a strict separation between immutable raw evidence (`raw/`), compiled semantic notes (`wiki/`), and progressive-disclosure root anchors (`.`): ![4-Layer OKF v0.3 Vault Compilation Stack](assets/vault-layer-topology.svg) --- ## 10 Portable Agent Skills and CLI Use **Knowledge Compiler** through slash commands inside your AI coding agent or directly from the terminal and CI pipelines: | Capability | Agent Skill | CLI Command | What It Does | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Multimodal Ingestion** | `/ingest` | `vault-extract` | Unpacks `.pptx`, `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.html`, `.mhtml`, and URLs into `raw/` with SHA-256 caching and a pure-stdlib OOXML fallback. | | **Session Distillation** | `/distill-session` | Agent workflow | Retrospectively compiles newly discovered architecture decisions, entities, and bug fixes from your chat trajectory into OKF notes. | | **In-Memory BM25 Search** | `/vault-query` | `vault-query` | Multi-field Okapi BM25 ranking across titles, tags, headings, and prose with duplicate detection (`--check-duplicate`) and zero index files. | | **Strict OKF Linting** | `/vault-lint` | `vault-lint` | Validates OKF v0.3 / v0.2 schemas, relative `.md` links, `[[wikilinks]]`, footnotes, drift (`--strict-drift`), v0.3 migration, and `--portable-links`. | | **Tri-State Fact Sweep** | `/vault-correct` | `vault-correct` | Safe plan-and-apply sweep that updates the canonical note, refactors living restatements into links, and preserves historical sources untouched. | | **60 FPS WebGL Graph** | `/vault-graph` | `vault-graph` | Serves the local 3D Orbit / 2D Force visualizer, inline Mermaid/table Reader, and Search Hub (`127.0.0.1:8765`), or exports standalone HTML. | | **Sanitized Sharing** | `/vault-share` & `/vault-pull` | `vault-sync-patterns` | Strips private entities and local paths before sharing reusable concepts to a team Git patterns repository (`--open-pr`) and pulls upstream updates safely. | | **DLP & Link Gate** | *(CLI / CI)* | `vault-sanitize-check` | Fail-closed scanner verifying zero leaked private identifiers, local paths, or broken links across shared pattern repositories. | | **Closed-Loop Skill Evals** | `/wikiskill` | `vault-analyze-trace`, `vault-wikiskill-eval` | Clusters redacted local tool-error traces and gates candidate `SKILL.md` refinements with deterministic offline Asymmetric Rollback evaluation. | | **Lifecycle Hook Manager** | *(CLI)* | `vault-hooks` | Inspects, enables, or disables the 3 opt-in hooks cleanly across both writable installs and read-only Marketplace mounts. | ### Using with AI Coding Agents and CI | Environment | Setup | Included Surfaces | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Antigravity & Agent Plugin Hosts** | Native root `plugin.json`, `skills/`, `rules/`, `hooks.json`, and `sidecars/vault_graph` | All 10 slash-command skills, workspace rule, opt-in hooks, and WebGL Graph side pane | | **Gemini CLI & `SKILL.md` Harnesses** | Run `kc-install-plugin` (or copy `skills/` and `rules/AGENTS.md`) | Portable `SKILL.md` bundles + `vault-*` console scripts | | **Standalone CLI & CI Pipelines** | `python3 -m pip install -e ".[extract]"` | Deterministic `vault-lint --strict --json`, `vault-query`, `vault-correct`, and `vault-graph --export` | --- ## Local-First Privacy and Offline Proof - **100% Local Default Operation**: All Markdown notes (`wiki/`, `index.md`, `log.md`), SHA-256 caches (`.ingest_cache.json`), and local WebGL views stay strictly on your filesystem and `127.0.0.1`. - **Independently Verifiable Offline Test**: Don't take our word for it. Run the bundled socket-blocking release gate, which monkeypatches `socket.socket` to raise on any network attempt across `vault-init`, `vault-lint`, `vault-query`, `vault-correct`, and `vault-graph`: ```bash python3 -m unittest tests.test_v1_release_gates.TestV1ReleaseGates.test_gate1_offline_plane1_socket_blocked ``` - **Explicit User-Initiated Network Calls Only**: Outbound requests happen only when you explicitly pass an HTTP(S) URL to `vault-extract`, run `vault-lint --check-okf-upstream`, run `vault-sync-patterns share --open-pr`, or opt in to Git `origin` sync hooks via `vault-hooks enable`.
What This Plugin Installs & Opt-In Lifecycle Hooks (All Disabled by Default)
- **10 Agent Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md`)**: `knowledge-compiler`, `ingest`, `distill-session`, `vault-correct`, `vault-query`, `vault-lint`, `vault-graph`, `vault-share`, `vault-pull`, and `wikiskill`. - **1 Workspace Rule (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Progressive disclosure and OKF v0.3 / v0.2 formatting guidelines. - **3 Lifecycle Hooks (`hooks.json`, all opt-in / disabled by default)**: - `wikiskill-error-recorder` (`PostToolUse`, **disabled by default**): Enable via `vault-hooks enable --hooks wikiskill` to capture redacted local tool failure diagnostics in `$XDG_STATE_HOME/knowledge-compiler/logs/error_traces.jsonl` (`~/.local/state/knowledge-compiler/logs/error_traces.jsonl`). - `vault-session-start` & `vault-stop-hook` (**disabled by default**): Enable via `vault-hooks enable` for users who explicitly back their vault with a Git `origin` remote (with OKF-aware union rebasing for `log.md` and `index.md`). - **1 Interactive Sidecar (`sidecars/vault_graph`)**: Local loopback 2D/3D WebGL Knowledge Graph server (`127.0.0.1:8765`). - **1 Clean-Room Starter Vault (`examples/starter-vault/`)**: 21-note / 32-file OKF v0.3 reference bundle passing official `validate.py --strict` with zero errors.
--- ## Stability, Troubleshooting, Contributing and Security - **Troubleshooting**: Run `vault-lint --fix` to repair broken links or escaped table pipes, `vault-lint --fix --migrate-v03` to upgrade an OKF v0.2 vault, or `vault-lint --fix --portable-links` to convert Obsidian `[[wikilinks]]` to standard OKF relative Markdown links. If port `8765` is busy, pass `--port ` to `vault-graph`. - **Stability & Compatibility**: See [STABILITY.md](STABILITY.md) for the frozen `1.x` CLI surface (`vault-*`), deterministic exit codes (`0`/`1`/`2`), JSON contract, and OKF v0.3 / v0.2 guarantees. - **Contributing**: Pull requests are welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for CLA, testing (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v`), and Apache-2.0 header guidelines. - **Feedback & Issues**: Report bugs or request features at [https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-compiler/issues](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-compiler/issues). - **Security**: See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting instructions (`https://g.co/vulnz`). --- ## Release History ### **v1.3.1** (`Latest`) - **Full OKF v0.3 Interoperability (`vault-lint`, `vault-graph`, `vault-init`, `examples/starter-vault/`)**: - **Portable Standard Relative Markdown Links (`--portable-links`)**: First-class validation, orphan/index tracking, BM25 excerpt unwrapping, and clickable WebGL Reader navigation for standard RFC 3986 `%20`-encoded relative Markdown links (`[Label](../dir/Note%20Name.md)`) alongside full backward compatibility for Obsidian `[[wikilinks]]`. Adds deterministic `vault-lint --fix --portable-links` conversion and upgrades `examples/starter-vault/` (434 inter-note Markdown links, 0 prose wikilinks) so generic OKF consumers (`okf-consume`, `viz.html`, GitHub, and Obsidian) all see the complete graph. - **Unambiguous OKF v0.3 Bundle Root (`.`) & Subdirectory Indexes (§8)**: Reports `"bundle_root": "."` and `"concepts_dir": "wiki"` in `vault-lint`, scaffolds frontmatter-free `wiki/index.md` on `vault-init`, and generates frontmatter-free `wiki/index.md` + `wiki//index.md` progressive-disclosure indexes in `examples/starter-vault/` and `--fix --migrate-v03`. - **OKF v0.3 §4.1 Namespaced `x-kc-*` Epistemic Extensions**: Adopts `x-kc-corroborates`, `x-kc-complements`, `x-kc-extends`, `x-kc-contradicts`, and `x-kc-supersedes` as canonical v0.3 frontmatter keys (migrated automatically by `--fix --migrate-v03` while remaining 100% backward-compatible with legacy unprefixed keys). `examples/starter-vault/` passes the official OKF v0.3 `validate.py --strict` with **0 errors, 0 warnings, and 0 info**.
Previous Releases (v1.2.0 – v1.0.0) ### **v1.2.0** - **Native Open Knowledge Format (`OKF v0.3`) Support with Full `v0.2` Backward Compatibility**: Upgrades `scripts/okf.py`, `scripts/init_vault.py`, `scripts/vault_lint.py`, `scripts/vault_graph.py`, `scripts/sync_patterns.py`, and `scripts/hooks/auto_sync_vault.py` to conform to the [OKF v0.3 specification](https://github.com/open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format): - **Root Bundle Metadata & Reserved Files (§8, §9)**: Fresh vaults emit `okf_version: "0.3"` with `title`/`description` in root `index.md` and frontmatter-free `log.md` using newest-first `## YYYY-MM-DD` date headings (with union merge support for both `v0.3` and legacy `v0.2` logs). - **Verification Currency & Fail-Closed Staleness (§5.3, §5.5, §11.2)**: `derive_trust_tier()` ignores verifications older than `generated.at` (`stale_verification_notes` tracked in `vault-lint --json`), unparseable `stale_after` fails closed as stale, and `parse_iso_datetime(..., require_offset=True)` enforces RFC 3339 offsets (date-only values map to UTC midnight). - **Path Resolution, `superseded_by` Edges, `team:` Actors & Attested Computation (§5.4, §6.2, §7, §10.2–§10.3)**: Supports relative vs leading-`/` bundle-root path resolution with automatic `v0.2` fallback, graphs `superseded_by` as `SUPERSEDES` edges, validates `team:` actors, `usage_window`/`usage_count`, and Attested Computation `parameters`/`executor`/`attester` + `# Computation` fence counts. - **One-Command Idempotent Migration (`vault-lint --fix --migrate-v03`)**: Deterministically upgrades existing `OKF v0.2` vaults (`index.md`, `log.md`, sub-`index.md`, and bare bundle-root path fields) to pass official OKF v0.3 validation with zero errors. - **21-Note OKF v0.3 Starter Vault & First-Run Read-Only Sample Preview (`vault-graph`)**: Ships a clean-room Google Cloud starter vault in `examples/starter-vault/` (lighting up all 7 node categories, all 6 epistemic edge types, 10 inline Mermaid diagrams, and 33 GFM tables), relative `.md` Markdown link graphing (`0` orphans on fresh `vault-init` vaults), a dismissible first-run welcome card, and a 1-click read-only `Sample Vault` / `My Vault` switcher in the WebGL visualizer. ### **v1.1.3** - **Zero-CDN Inline SVG Mermaid & GFM Table Reader (`vault-graph`)**: Renders Mermaid `flowchart`/`graph` (nested subgraphs, sibling grids, labeled solid/dashed/thick/bidirectional edges), `sequenceDiagram`, and `pie` charts inline as CSP-safe SVG 1.1 with a full-screen lightbox (`Expand`) plus GFM Markdown tables inside the WebGL Reader drawer, alongside hardened desktop sidecar gateway and Linux VM forwarding. - **Opt-In Lifecycle Hook Manager (`vault-hooks`) & Upgrade Preservation**: Adds `scripts/vault_hooks.py` (`status`, `enable`, `disable`) handling both writable plugin directories and read-only (`EROFS`) Marketplace mounts via non-colliding `kc-user-*` entries in user config, while `install_plugin.py` preserves existing `"enabled"` booleans across upgrades. - **`/wikiskill` Graduated to `Stable` (`vault-wikiskill-eval` & `vault-analyze-trace --propose`)**: Adds deterministic offline Asymmetric Rollback Evaluation (`scripts/wikiskill_eval.py`) with SHA-256 CAS updates strictly limited to `wiki/skill-impact.md`, plus redacted out-of-vault proposal clustering (`0700`/`0600`) in `scripts/analyze_trace.py`. - **Graph Intelligence (`vault-lint` & `vault-graph`)**: Adds synthesis drift detection (`stale_syntheses`, `--strict-drift`), plain-text unlinked mention scanning (`--mentions`), two-phase CAS entity/concept deduplication (`--dedup-manifest` / `--apply-manifest`), one-command isolated worktree pattern PRs (`vault-sync-patterns share --open-pr`), and lazy `/api/note` markdown loading in `vault_graph.py`. - **Open Source Compliance CI Gate (`tests/test_oss_cross_compliance.py`)**: Enforces Apache-2.0 headers, UTF-8/LF endings, clean-room disclaimers, and zero secret/sensitive tokens on every CI run. ### **v1.0.0** - **`1.x` Stability & Unified `vault-*` CLI Contract ([STABILITY.md](STABILITY.md))**: Standardizes `vault-init`, `vault-extract`, `vault-lint`, `vault-correct`, `vault-query`, `vault-graph`, `vault-sync-patterns`, `vault-sanitize-check`, and `kc-install-plugin` with deterministic exit codes (`0`/`1`/`2`). - **Zero-Dependency In-Memory BM25 Retrieval & Incremental Graph Cache**: Adds `vault-query` (`scripts/vault_query.py`) with identifier splitting, CJK bigrams, duplicate check (`--check-duplicate`), and raw fence isolation (`--include-raw`), plus `(mtime_ns, ctime_ns, size)` incremental caching in `vault-graph`. - **Pluggable Federation Architecture**: `FederationProvider` interface (`scripts/federation_provider.py`) supporting `LocalGitPatternProvider` for a Git-backed shared patterns repository. - **Marketplace Native Packaging**: Top-level `plugin.json`, `hooks.json`, `skills/`, `rules/`, and `sidecars/vault_graph` ready for one-click installation. - **Zero-Dependency OOXML Extraction**: Pure-Python stdlib XML/ZIP fallback extractors for `.pptx`, `.docx`, and `.xlsx` alongside `pypdf` and `python-pptx`.
--- ## Disclaimer This is not an officially supported Google product. Eligibility for the [Google Open Source Software Vulnerability Rewards Program](https://bughunters.google.com/open-source-security) is determined by the Google OSS VRP Rules.

What This Plugin Installs & Opt-In Lifecycle Hooks (All Disabled by Default)
- **10 Agent Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md`)**: `knowledge-compiler`, `ingest`, `distill-session`, `vault-correct`, `vault-query`, `vault-lint`, `vault-graph`, `vault-share`, `vault-pull`, and `wikiskill`. - **1 Workspace Rule (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Progressive disclosure and OKF v0.3 / v0.2 formatting guidelines. - **3 Lifecycle Hooks (`hooks.json`, all opt-in / disabled by default)**: - `wikiskill-error-recorder` (`PostToolUse`, **disabled by default**): Enable via `vault-hooks enable --hooks wikiskill` to capture redacted local tool failure diagnostics in `$XDG_STATE_HOME/knowledge-compiler/logs/error_traces.jsonl` (`~/.local/state/knowledge-compiler/logs/error_traces.jsonl`). - `vault-session-start` & `vault-stop-hook` (**disabled by default**): Enable via `vault-hooks enable` for users who explicitly back their vault with a Git `origin` remote (with OKF-aware union rebasing for `log.md` and `index.md`). - **1 Interactive Sidecar (`sidecars/vault_graph`)**: Local loopback 2D/3D WebGL Knowledge Graph server (`127.0.0.1:8765`). - **1 Clean-Room Starter Vault (`examples/starter-vault/`)**: 21-note / 32-file OKF v0.3 reference bundle passing official `validate.py --strict` with zero errors.
